g.text: During return transit Order remains RESULT_NOTIFIED.
Shipment holds TO_SELLER IN_TRANSIT, not an extra Order state.
Negative results have no CONFIRM or certificate.
Fresh DB clock after lock and I/O revalidation governs writes.
Timely report blocks AUTO; outage/unreadable proof leaves HELD.
Failure preserves proof and HELD for scheduled retry.
Full original held total; original Payment/Receipt unchanged.
validated frozen return address / timely ship
REJECT or negative / TO_SELLER confirmed proof
Buyer receipt OR eligible AUTO / one RELEASE
Target submission behavior; current baseline still needs FINISH.
COMPLETED permits one seller review; refund does not.
Inspection overdue escalates without inventing transitions.
